rules: ordinary direct state assignment outside the owning command/job/recovery choreography is forbidden
verified and restored both mean the catalog has verification evidence; current artifact existence/digest must still be revalidated before restore or prune decisions
failed/pruned rows remain history and are never hard-deleted by ordinary runtime
restore reconciliation may only use the special building|verifying -> restored transition for the exact authenticated source backup_id; all other historical building/verifying rows become failed
every accepted state transition increments managed_backup_catalog.revision exactly once and writes the required audit/evidence owned by its governing operation
